variant.description: Whether the token was minted for the preset's stored document (sluis on its schedule) or on demand for the caller.

kind.description: What the preset hands out: an API token, or R2 (S3) credentials.

account.description: The preset's Cloudflare account, by the name the service document gives it.

credential_id.description: The minted (or revoked) token's id in Cloudflare; for R2 it is the access key id. Never the value.

credential_ids.description: The ids of the Cloudflare tokens swept.

expires_on.description: When Cloudflare stops accepting the token (RFC 3339).

reason.description: Why nothing was minted: not_granted, lifetime_too_long, unknown_preset, prototype_active, prototype_forbidden, prototype_missing, minter_missing, cloudflare_error or store_error.

detail.description: What the check found, for a refused prototype (the permission group names); never a value.
